composition: Dudok tower, wide canopy, and dark IJsselmeer · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Vlietermonument marks the 1932 closure of the Afsluitdijk: a concrete tower by Dudok, with a basalt base, a wide canopy, and a copper roof, standing over the IJsselmeer. The sky is overcast, about 16.6°C, with wind near 9.4 km/h. The public rest area is closed while works continue, so no terrace crowd is shown, and no scaffold stands on the tower. Breezanddijk, the midpoint hamlet, is a different place.
